scenarios.title: Spectacle can be paid only if an opponent lost life this turn
decisions: A casts Shock targeting player B, tapping one Mountain.
A considers casting Skewer the Critics with the second Mountain.

variants.label: opponent_lost_life
variants.expected: B's life goes from 20 to 18. Casting Skewer the Critics for its spectacle cost {R} is legal.

variants.label: no_life_lost
variants.delta: Shock targets Grizzly Bears instead of player B.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears dies and B's life stays 20. Casting Skewer the Critics is not legal: the spectacle cost is unavailable and {2}{R} cannot be paid with one Mountain.

operation.unclassifiable: target: Shock targets Grizzly Bears instead of player B

variants.label: own_life_lost
variants.delta: Shock targets player A instead of player B.
variants.expected: A's life goes from 20 to 18 and B's stays 20. Casting Skewer the Critics is not legal: the spectacle cost is unavailable because no opponent lost life.

operation.unclassifiable: target: Shock targets player A instead of player B

detector.outcome: A candidate cast through its spectacle cost is playable because an opponent lost life this turn.
detector.near_miss: A candidate cast through its spectacle cost that is not playable.
